project.description:
📦 SSL/TLS PFX Packager

Combines the certificate authority response with the generated private key into a PKCS#12 (.pfx) bundle and safely archives it.

org.biouno.unochoice.ChoiceParameter.name: commonName
org.biouno.unochoice.ChoiceParameter.description: Select the Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) used for the CSR. (Auto-populated from metadata registry)

hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.name: CERT_PATH/ca.pem
hudson.model.FileParameterDefinition.description: Upload CA Bundle certificate in .pem format

hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.name: azure_keyvault_uri
hudson.model.ChoiceParameterDefinition.description: Select Azure Key Vault to upload PFX certificate

hudson.tasks.Shell.command: csrDate=$(echo ${private_key_file} | sed -E 's/.*_([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}).*/\1/') azure_keyvault_cert_name=$(echo ${commonName} | tr . -) cp CERT_PATH/crt.pem /site-data/csr-certs/${commonName}/${commonName}_${csrDate}.crt.pem cp CERT_PATH/ca.pem /site-data/csr-certs/${commonName}/${commonName}_${csrDate}.ca.pem ansible-playbook -u "$ANSIBLE_USER" --private-key "$ANSIBLE_PVT_KEY" --extra-vars "commonName=${commonName} csrDate=${csrDate} private_key_file=${private_key_file} azure_keyvault_cert_name=${azure_keyvault_cert_name} azure_keyvault_uri=${azure_keyvault_uri}" /etc/ansible/playbooks/generate_pfx.yml
